t.zh: 砖块一层层摆成三角形：第 1 层 1 块，第 2 层 2 块……从最顶上那块出发，每一步走到正下方或右下方的砖。
t.en: Bricks are stacked in a triangle: 1 brick in row 1, 2 in row 2, and so on. Starting from the top brick, each step goes to the brick right below or below-right.

t.zh: 表的形状也变成了三角形：每一层只有那么几格。
t.en: The table becomes a triangle too: each row has only so many cells.

goal.zh: 走到最后一层的指定那块砖，一共有几条路？
goal.en: How many ways are there down to the given brick of the last row?

how.en: Row by row, left to right.

say.zh: 往下走只会到正下方或右下方，所以来路在上一层：正上方和左上方。
say.en: Moving down only reaches the brick below or below-right, so the ways in are on the row above: right above and up-left.

hints.zh: 只看最后一步：走到这块砖之前，你在哪一块上？
hints.en: Look only at the last step: before reaching this brick, which brick were you on?

hints.zh: 三角形左边缘和右边缘的砖，只有一块砖能走过来，另一边是「—」。
hints.en: Bricks on the triangle’s left and right edges can be reached from one brick only; the other side is “—”.

body.zh: 每块砖的数 = 正上方 + 左上方。这就是杨辉三角，也是「从 n 个里选 k 个」的方法数。
body.en: Each brick’s number = right above + up-left. This is Pascal’s triangle, and also the number of ways to choose k things out of n.

body.zh: 表不一定是方的：只要每格知道自己的来路，什么形状都能填。
body.en: A table need not be square: any shape can be filled, as long as each cell knows its ways in.
